arguments.sql:
SELECT e.Diagnosis, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.Symptoms) AS observed_symptoms,
       MIN(p.Birthday) AS earliest_birth, MAX(e."Examination Date") AS latest_exam,
       COUNT(*) AS examinations, COUNT(p.ID) AS matched_examinations
FROM Examination AS e
LEFT JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%sle%' OR e.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%'
GROUP BY e.Diagnosis

WITH exams AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e."Examination Date", e.Symptoms,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(e.Diagnosis), '->', ','), '+', ','), ', ', ',') AS diseases
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
)
SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis
FROM exams AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE (',' || e.diseases || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC, p.ID ASC, e."Examination Date" DESC
LIMIT 1
